answer: Payout climbs to a summit in rungs. Each rung needs a fable: a stranger client, not the agent, tells the checkable story of one completed job, naming the thread of prior jobs it builds on. Threads entangle: two identities whose threads share the same clients or jobs are both cut and lose every rung. Each rung's fee doubles, so n clones pay n fables from n strangers, n distinct threads, and fees rising 2,4,8 while the summit pays one capped prize per funding cluster. One honest agent climbs once, cheaply; a fleet's cost explodes while its revenue stays capped.
